SELECT @rownum := @rownum + 1 AS rankNo, sku.sku_code AS goodsCode, COALESCE(spu.goods_name, sku.sku_name) AS goodsName, sku.spec, sku.unit, SUM(sout_item.quantity) AS saleQuantity, SUM(sout_item.sub_total) AS saleAmount, SUM(sout_item.cost_amount) AS costAmount, SUM(sout_item.sub_total - sout_item.cost_amount) AS profitAmount, CASE WHEN SUM(sout_item.sub_total) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(sout_item.sub_total - sout_item.cost_amount) / SUM(sout_item.sub_total)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS profitRate FROM wms_sales_out_item sout_item INNER JOIN wms_sales_out sout ON sout_item.sales_out_id = sout.id INNER JOIN wms_goods_sku sku ON sout_item.sku_id = sku.id LEFT JOIN wms_goods spu ON sku.goods_id = spu.id CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rownum := 0) r WHERE sout.del_flag = 0 AND sout_item.del_flag = 0
AND DATE(sout.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND DATE(sout.create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
AND spu.category_id IN
#{id}
AND sout.warehouse_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY sku.sku_code, sku.sku_name, spu.goods_name, sku.spec, sku.unit ORDER BY
SUM(sout_item.quantity) DESC
SUM(sout_item.sub_total - sout_item.cost_amount) DESC
SUM(sout_item.sub_total) DESC
LIMIT 100
